breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the flexural second moment of area I (not the polar moment J) in the curvature relation κ = M/(E·I), matching the ground truth. It explicitly states 'Ignore the polar second moment J; it plays no role in this calculation,' directly correcting the error introduced in the incomplete prompt.
